Class Player

java.lang.Object
model.Player
public class Player extends Object
Represents a player in the game.

This class maintains the player's state, including current money, board position, jail status, and any skip-turn penalties. It also handles movement logic and financial transactions.

    • deductMoney

      public boolean deductMoney(int amount)
      Deducts money from the player's balance.

      If the player has enough funds, the amount is deducted and the method returns true. If funds are insufficient, the money is still deducted (resulting in a negative balance or bankruptcy), and the method returns false.

      Parameters:
      amount - The amount to pay.
      Returns:
      true if payment was successful with positive balance; false otherwise.

    • goToJail

      public void goToJail()
      Sends the player to Jail.

      Moves the player to the Jail square (index 5), sets the inJail flag to true, and sets the jailTurns penalty to 2.

    • releaseFromJail

      public void releaseFromJail()
      Releases the player from Jail immediately. Resets jail status and jail turn counter.

    • decrementJailTurns

      public void decrementJailTurns()
      Decrements the jail sentence counter. Typically called when a player chooses to wait out their sentence.

    • move

      public void move(int steps)
      Moves the player forward by a specified number of steps.

      Handles wrapping around the board (modulo arithmetic) and checks for the "Pass Go" event. If the player passes Go, they receive $20.

      Parameters:
      steps - The number of steps to move.

    • warp

      public void warp(int position)
      Teleports the player to a specific position without triggering movement events (like passing Go).
      Parameters:
      position - The target index on the board.
